feeTo.mustBe: externally owned account; an EIP-7702 delegation only to an identified delegate holding its recorded code (any other is refused); a designator other than the recorded one is a warning
feeTo.proofOfControl: deployments/fee-address-proof.json: required by the pre gate on the public chain

firstDepositor.mustBe: the address check-depositor.mjs recorded: a dedicated key account, not the fee address, no code, no EIP-7702 delegation, no transaction on the chain before the factory is deployed

openingPrice.minimumReason: At least 1 ETH and its USDC at the market price: the first deposit costs about 2.54 million gas: 0.013 ETH at 5 gwei, which is 0.64% of a deposit worth 2 ETH (1 ETH and its USDC); below 1 ETH the gas of opening and of every later change dominates. Inflating the first share is not possible at any size (only the depositing account can mint first, and the pair locks 1,000 share units); the tool also refuses a deposit whose share supply would be under 10^12 units, so that the locked units are at most a billionth of it.

Inflating the first share is not possible at any size (only the depositing account can mint first, and the pair locks 1,000 share units); the tool also refuses a deposit whose share supply would be under 10^12 units, so that the locked units are at most a billionth of it.
